specifications.scope: The main asymptotic assertion, formulated for labelled finite simple graphs on Fin n, existence of a proper edge coloring with maxDegree colors, and absence of overfull induced vertex sets.

The full assertion of Proposition 7.1 for every odd Delta >= 3: a connected simple graph on Fin (4*Delta+5), maximum degree Delta, no proper Delta-edge-coloring, a proper (Delta+1)-edge-coloring, no Delta-overfull vertex set, and exactly 2*Delta*(Delta+1) edges. The two coloring statements express the exact class-2 conclusion without invoking Vizing’s theorem.
